scenes.text: Equivalent ratios multiply or divide BOTH parts by the same positive factor.
Write an equivalent ratio to 1:2 using factor 4. The answer is 4:8. Multiply both parts by 4 to get 4:8.
A recipe on a football field mixes fruit and water in the ratio 8:5. Which ratio keeps the same taste when quantities are multiplied by 3? Pause to choose and explain.
A recipe on a football field mixes fruit and water in the ratio 8:5. Which ratio keeps the same taste when quantities are multiplied by 3? The answer is 24:15. Multiply both parts by 3 to get 24:15.
